description: A React component for managing and validating outgoing OAuth connection configurations in Mattermost, including form handling, validation, and UI rendering.

classes.name: ValidateButton
classes.description: A React component for rendering the validation button and status messages for OAuth connection validation.

methods.name: useOutgoingOAuthForm
methods.description: Custom hook for managing the form state of the OAuth connection configuration.

methods.name: AbstractOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Main React component for creating, editing, and validating outgoing OAuth connections.

methods.name: handleValidate
methods.description: Handles the validation process of the OAuth connection by dispatching validation actions.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, including validation and confirmation modals.

methods.name: setUnvalidated
methods.description: Marks the form as unvalidated and clears validation errors.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the connection name in form state.

methods.name: updateClientId
methods.description: Updates the client ID in form state.

methods.name: updateClientSecret
methods.description: Updates the client secret in form state.

methods.name: updateOAuthTokenURL
methods.description: Updates the OAuth token URL in form state.

methods.name: updateAudienceUrls
methods.description: Updates the audience URLs in form state.

methods.name: startEditingClientSecret
methods.description: Enables editing of the client secret.
